## Problem

What workflow or security review problem would this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful version of the change.

## Examples

Include a vulnerable example, a safe example, or a representative repository when possible. Do not include secrets or private code.

## Tradeoffs

What false positives, false negatives, performance cost, compatibility impact, or user-facing complexity should be considered?
